function.name: read
function.description: Read a file inside the attempt. Refuses paths outside the jail and files over the byte cap.

function.name: glob
function.description: List files inside the attempt whose relative path matches the pattern. Does not leave the jail.

function.name: grep
function.description: Literal search inside the attempt. Not a shell pipeline.

function.name: edit
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence. Requires the oracle to have failed first. Refuses a missing or repeated old string.

function.name: write
function.description: Create a new file. Refuses a path that already exists. Requires the oracle to have failed first.

function.name: archive
function.description: Move a file into _delme and append a ledger line. This is the only removal hand.

function.name: oracle
function.description: Re-run the bound oracle and return its exit code. The verify hook, not this hand, decides done.

function.name: worktree
function.description: Create one directory under worktrees/ inside the jail. Does not call git.
